mechanisms.name: initial_autonomy_reciprocity
mechanisms.source_support: no population joint distribution inferred

mechanisms.name: initial_trust_fatigue_learning
mechanisms.source_support: trust is not measured psychological safety

mechanisms.name: participation
mechanisms.dependencies: same-day information snapshot; attendance includes zero-weight members
mechanisms.source_support: observed attendance and normalized positive participating weight are separate measures, not full causal real-authority construct

mechanisms.name: decision_information
mechanisms.source_support: finite signal model and error-correlation stress alternative; coefficients unestimated

mechanisms.name: authority_motivation
mechanisms.source_support: DAMS-specific conjecture; zero and reversed response alternatives required for scope

mechanisms.name: effort
mechanisms.source_support: directional opportunity-cost rationale; coefficients unestimated

mechanisms.name: alternative_effort
mechanisms.dependencies: same observable information; chosen effort clipped by finite time
mechanisms.source_support: structure alternatives, not fitted psychological laws; aspiration and step sizes design choices

mechanisms.name: cooperation
mechanisms.source_support: not the empirical study's measured construct or fitted effect

mechanisms.name: task_generation
mechanisms.source_support: synthetic tasks and stress severity

mechanisms.name: production
mechanisms.source_support: construct operationalization; no marginal-product truth or universal production law

mechanisms.name: fatigue_learning
mechanisms.source_support: learning dynamics are a conjecture, not recovered parameters

mechanisms.name: audit_sensors
mechanisms.expression: review alarm: fraud .6 / honest .02; appeal alarm: fraud .9 / honest .01
mechanisms.dependencies: truth generates alarm; reviewer sees alarm only
mechanisms.source_support: stress assumptions; performance must be varied, not called measured accuracy

mechanisms.name: acceptance_and_trust
mechanisms.expression: observed_work>=.25 and no audit alarm; appeal if observed_work>=.25 and trust>.2; successful commit+.015, initial review rejection-.025, censorship-.03
mechanisms.source_support: normative procedural thresholds and feedback assumptions; initial acceptance alone does not increase trust

mechanisms.name: backend_bounds
mechanisms.expression: defaults central/witness/consensus: censor exposure 1/.5/0; review multipliers 1/1.2/1.5; settlement 1/2/3; consensus commit suspended during configured quorum-unavailability interval
mechanisms.dependencies: shared workload and explicit backend class; configurable alternative bounds
mechanisms.source_support: idealized stress bounds, not measured distributed-systems performance; zero censorship requires the declared trust assumptions and does not eliminate quorum failure

mechanisms.name: time_reservations
mechanisms.source_support: resource bookkeeping, not measured organizational costs or real calendar hours

mechanisms.name: attack_time
mechanisms.expression: k=min(n,max(1,ceil(n*attack_cohort_fraction))); first k stable IDs reserve budget/k before effort; cohort fixed across budgets; infeasible individual budget fails; no active attack when budget=0; censor requires ceil(n*f)<n
mechanisms.dependencies: same attack budget across policies, charged finite time
mechanisms.source_support: stress design and opportunity cost, not empirical attacker behavior

mechanisms.name: daily_service_capacity
mechanisms.expression: review_slots=floor(guild_size*review_capacity/backend_multiplier); appeal_slots=floor(guild_size*appeal_capacity); unused whole and fractional capacities expire daily
mechanisms.dependencies: guild size, human reservation and backend multiplier
mechanisms.source_support: resource bookkeeping assumption; small guilds can have zero service despite positive reservation; no banked fractional capacity

mechanisms.name: queue_priority
mechanisms.expression: order by ready day then uniform(review_priority,world,creation_day,person); carry priority through review, appeal and commitment
mechanisms.unit: ready day and dimensionless lottery rank
mechanisms.source_support: common lottery avoids deterministic ID queue privilege; not an empirically estimated scheduling process

mechanisms.name: review_counter_semantics
mechanisms.expression: fraudulent_records_detected counts initial review rejections of fraudulent claims; fraudulent_records_accepted counts unique fraudulent commits; honest_records_rejected counts honest review rejection events
mechanisms.unit: review events and committed records, kept separate
mechanisms.dependencies: credit threshold, audit alarm, appeals, replay suppression and finite horizon
mechanisms.source_support: fraud initial rejection can overlap later appeal commitment; honest review rejection can include duplicate claims or legitimate threshold failures; these counts are not a mutually exclusive cohort partition or sensor-accuracy rates

mechanisms.name: dynamic_attack_mechanics
mechanisms.expression: forge adds budget/k observed credit; duplicate adds one copy/attacker/day; freeride removes min(effort,budget/k) additional effort and sets help=0; censor targets nonattackers with probability min(1,budget/n)*backend_exposure
mechanisms.unit: synthetic hour-equivalents, observed credit, copied claims and probability kept separate
mechanisms.dependencies: fixed attacker cohort, reserved time, observed work and exposure vector
mechanisms.source_support: forge uses an assumed one-unit time-to-credit conversion; duplicate volume stays fixed across budgets; attack returns and probabilities are controlled stress assumptions, not estimated criminal behavior
